title: 1Password credential provider freezes mRemoteNG and 1Password until op times out (blocking call on UI thread)
author: JScheller88
body_snippet:
**Summary**
When a connection uses the 1Password credential provider and 1Password has to authorize the CLI for mRemoteNG, both mRemoteNG and 1Password freeze. The 1Password authorization window appears blank and "Not Responding". After about 2 minutes `op` fails with:

```
1Password read failed
Error running op item get: [ERROR] ... error initializing client: authorization timeout
```

Both apps then recover.

comments.author: JScheller88
comments.snippet: The auth pop-up during the issue. The error after the the apps respond again. I have rebooted my machine and the issue persists with no other apps running.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the precise report, screenshots and reboot check. The CLI read was synchronous inside the connection UI path, even though initialization had an async entry point.

Commit `0b5b5802f` moves the 1Password lookup off the UI thread for RDP, PuTTY, RD Gateway and default credentials. Async reads are serialized, both output streams are drained concurrently, and the owned CLI process is stopped after a 60-second wait. There is no session credential cache.
